summary: About page reference for an AI or SaaS product — #337EC8 accent, Inter, a stats row and a 640x472 frame.
about: Build With Us is a working reference for an AI or SaaS product: the about page laid out, measured and ready to rebuild. Colour is limited to white #FFFFFF underneath, deep yellow #434437 for the type and blue #337EC8 carrying the accents, set in Inter. It ships as React and Tailwind CSS, so the whole about page can be lifted into a project without a design handoff. It is the right reference for an AI or SaaS product about page that has to look deliberate on the first screen.

layout.title: A bar with nothing spare
layout.body: The bar is the quietest part of the composition: wordmark, a short row of links and one #337EC8 action, all held at the smallest type step in the brief. The links are set below the wordmark in size, and the #337EC8 action is the only element in the bar with any weight. Give the wordmark no more room than its type needs.

layout.title: Numbers carried into the build
layout.body: The layout works on absolute values rather than ratios: 100vh sections and 48px spacing steps. A rebuild that hits those numbers looks like the reference without further tuning. Keep the named values when you port the page.

layout.title: One face, used with discipline
layout.body: The type is Inter at the top of the scale, with the supporting copy dropped well below it so the hierarchy needs no colour to read. The display face is used at one size only, so it never competes with itself.

layout.title: Copy first, decoration second
layout.body: The whole composition fits one screen and is delivered as React and Tailwind CSS, with the copy, the media and the controls named in the brief. The page is one composition at 640x472, which is why it holds together when the copy changes.

motion.title: Hover, but sparingly
motion.body: The page answers only where it can be acted on: hover states on the buttons and links rather than on every card. Each state changes one property, which keeps the feedback legible.

motion.title: Almost no motion
motion.body: The brief leaves animation out and lets the 640x472 layout carry the page, with hover and press states the only changes. There is no animation library in the brief, which keeps the rebuild small.

notes: The accent is spent on blue #337EC8 and the rest of the composition holds white #FFFFFF.
Accent and ground are both named (blue #337EC8 on white #FFFFFF), so a brand swap moves one value.
Accent use is limited to blue #337EC8; everything else sits on white #FFFFFF.

customize: Replace the copy in the Inter stack first, then re-check the #337EC8 accent against the media behind it.
Keep the 640x472 frame when you swap the content, because the composition was solved against that ratio.
Keep the about page inside one viewport and move whatever does not fit into the section below it.
Read the brief value by value against the 640x472 capture before you edit anything; the numbers are the part that is easiest to lose.

editorial.title: What this about page gets right
editorial.body: There is one promise on this page, and 100vh sections and 48px spacing steps hold it in place. Nothing below the fold is asked to carry the offer as well. It gives a SaaS reader the shortest honest route to the offer.

editorial.title: What to change first in Build With Us
editorial.body: The brief names Inter and the scale beside it. Substitute a face with the same proportions and the composition survives. The frame and the scale are what to leave alone.

editorial.title: How the about page reflows
editorial.body: There is no separate mobile design to maintain. the section is held at 100vh, and the same hierarchy carries across. The order is the last thing to change.

steps: Start in Studio with the prompt prefilled, then delete the parts of the about page you do not need.
Open the reference in Studio with the prompt staged, and read the about page brief before you send it.
Type the product name and the #337EC8 accent before you touch the layout.
Drop your product name in, then replace #337EC8 with your own accent and re-check the contrast.
Set the brand first: product name, the #337EC8 accent and a headline that replaces the reference's.

faq.question: How long is the prompt behind Build With Us?
faq.answer: The captured brief runs 6,252 characters and covers the frame, the type scale, the palette and the transitions. Copying it gives you that text, and sending it to Studio stages the same request with the page already described.

faq.question: How is this Build With Us entry organised?
faq.answer: Everything quoted on the page comes from the captured 6,252-character brief rather than from a description written afterwards. That is why the numbers and the prose agree.

faq.question: Can I rebuild the Build With Us about page in a different stack?
faq.answer: Build With Us was built in React and Tailwind CSS, and the entry says so for provenance. The brief describes positions, sizes and timings, so it rebuilds in any framework that can set type and place elements.

audience: Product managers who have to estimate the build will read a 640x472 frame as the scope of the work.
Start from 100vh sections and 48px spacing steps and let the palette follow, because the spacing is what makes this about page read.
Studio leads who run several projects at once will use this about page as the pattern every other page copies.
